rationale: Source-based note on the earlier snapshot-trigger Fact, whose wording implied a per-interval recurrence that the later measurement did not support and whose consequence was measured with a proxy I have since shown to be unusable. The premise that changed is the consequence: the verdict is spurious and redundant snapshot creation at the unchanged index was witnessed, but the recurrence rate is unmeasured and stored-snapshot counts cannot measure it, so the Fact's consequence sentence must say only what was observed. No new claim is introduced and the asserted defect, its bound and its limitations are unchanged. The durable Fact itself is left unchanged in this cycle: attempting to revise it requires a revision-qualified reference that this batch did not supply, so the correction is recorded here and can be carried into the Fact under its own id in a later update.
